title: Public Health Analytics-OS JSON Schema package

compatibility.additionalProperties: Existing definition contracts retain their 1.0 compatibility boundary; the new value contracts close extension points to prevent accidental person-level or unidentified fields.
compatibility.legacyProgrammeTuples: Accepted for existing programme releases; new programme records should use named objects.
compatibility.validationBoundary: Structural validity does not imply source verification, semantic equivalence, computability, comparability, privacy clearance, domain review or custodian approval.
compatibility.backwardCompatibility: Package 1.1.0 adds aggregate-observation and reference-value contracts without invalidating records conformant to package 1.0.0.
